answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in umber, and vertex lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 7 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 3804 identities would post 4937 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
